messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
The provided passages do not yet support a head-to-head Aerospace / Defense competitor comparison for a “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer” solution, because the raw evidence only names “Signal Generator” and “Signal Analyzer” without models, specs, competitor, or test conditions, and the Aerospace / Defense passage only identifies an A&D test presentation/presenter without linking to that solution or to a competitor [99][97].
### Evidence required before making the comparison
| Evidence required | What it must prove | Why it is required |
|---|---|---|
| Exact R&S configuration | The specific signal generator and analyzer models, options, orderable configuration, and applicable specifications; for SMW200A, the KB points to the official configuration guide and specifications, and notes that complete multichannel, MIMO, fading, digital standards, GNSS/avionics, and pulse sequencer specs require separate referenced documents [1][61][63]. | Without exact models/options, a comparison can only be a generic product claim, not a supported technical comparison [1][61]. |
| R&S warranted specification conditions | R&S specs must be used under their stated product-data conditions: storage 3 hours at ambient temperature, 30 minutes warm-up, specified environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval, and applicable internal automatic adjustments; `typ.`, `nom.`, `meas.`, and `n. trc.` values are not warranted for SMW200A [2][27]. | Claims should use warranted specifications with their conditions, not typical or nominal values as guaranteed performance [2][27]. |
| Analyzer specification basis | For analyzers, the KB lists formal specification sources and conditions, such as FSV3000 PD 5216.1334.22 Version 16.01 August 2025, with 3-hour storage, 30-minute warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and automatic adjustments; non-traceable, typical, nominal, measured, and tolerance-free data are not binding [4][8]. | A Signal Analyzer comparison needs binding analyzer specifications and their conditions, not unqualified numbers [4][8]. |
| Application / A&D use-case link | If the use case is satellite payload testing, the KB supports R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A for complete payload testing covering group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality [48]. | This supports an application fit for satellite payload testing, but it is not itself a competitor comparison [48]. |
| Measurement-method evidence | For satellite payload group delay, the KB states that SMW200A generates a multicarrier continuous wave stimulus and FSW performs reference calibration and DUT measurement using phase/amplitude differences [49]. | A fair comparison needs the same measurement principle, setup, DUT conditions, and metrics for both solutions [49]. |
| Competitor official or third-party evidence | R&S internal battle-card claims against competitors require competitor official資料 and third-party evidence before use in customer documents; sales phrases such as “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “widest frequency range,” and “lower TCO” should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications [17][38]. | Competitor superiority, limitation, or TCO claims are unsupported unless the competitor source or third-party evidence states them [17][38]. |
| Same-scope competitor configuration | The Starlink UT test-flow mapping lists R&S FSW vs Keysight N9040B UXA for spectrum analyzer and R&S SMW200A vs Keysight E8257D PSG for signal generator, but says these are deck-level recommendations and formal configuration requires checking product specs, options, frequency range, uncertainty, and test method [40]. | This can identify candidate competitor instruments, but it cannot by itself prove better performance or suitability [40]. |
| Formal datasheet verification for recommended equipment | The Starlink User Terminal page again states that recommended equipment such as R&S FSW, R&S SMW200A, Keysight N9040B UXA, and Keysight E8257D PSG require verification of formal frequency range, POI, power uncertainty, option requirements, and order numbers in each product datasheet [43]. | Deck-level equipment lists must not be used as final technical or procurement evidence [43]. |
| Limits of application brochures | Satellite payload / TVAC application material is solution-level or application-level material and must not replace product datasheets, option/order-number checks, or qualification certificates [23][46]. | Application notes can support use-case context but not formal product qualification or binding specs [23][46]. |
| Market or sales claims separation | Internal market or sales-comparison decks may include competitor positioning, price point, coverage, TCO, or market-share statements, but the KB says such claims require official award notices, PO/PR/lab lists, third-party market reports, or official competitor sources before use as evidence [58][59]. | Market-share, adoption, price, TCO, and “why we win” claims need separate evidence from technical specs [58][59]. |
### Minimum supported comparison package
| Claim type | Required evidence before saying it |
|---|---|
| “Our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution fits Aerospace / Defense use case X.” | A cited source tying the exact R&S generator/analyzer models to that exact use case; the KB currently supports FSW + SMW200A for satellite payload testing, not a general A&D competitor claim [48]. |
| “Our solution outperforms competitor Y.” | R&S warranted specs, competitor official specs or third-party data, same test conditions, and a cited comparison source; R&S battle cards alone are sales positioning and not binding specifications [17][38]. |
| “Our solution needs fewer boxes / lower TCO / higher throughput.” | A cited TCO, workflow, or throughput calculation with configuration, assumptions, and source; the KB flags lower TCO and similar language as sales language or internal comparison unless separately evidenced [17][38][58]. |
| “These instruments are formally recommended for the customer/test flow.” | A source beyond deck-level recommendation, because the Starlink mapping says formal configuration must be verified against datasheets, options, frequency range, uncertainty, and test method [40][43]. |

- 文件日期：`May 2024`。
- 文件性質：configuration guide；適合查 mandatory configuration、requires / not compatible / retrofitting notes、ordering information、recommended extras 與 service notes。

- 來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]。
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`。
- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.22`。
- 文件版次：`Version 31.00`。
- 文件日期：`May 2026`。
- 文件性質：產品 specifications；記錄 RF/baseband performance、interfaces、environmental data、ordering information 與 options。

R&S SMW200A › 規格適用條件與語彙
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）：

- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 下 storage `3 hours` 後 warm-up operation `30 minutes`、符合 specified environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval、完成所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- Specifications with limits 與 specifications without limits 代表 warranted product performance。
- `n. trc.`、`typ.`、`nom.`、`meas.` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- Uncertainties 的 coverage factor 為 `2`，依 GUM 計算。
- 依 3GPP standard，本文件中的 `Gbps`、`Mcps`、`Mbps`、`Msps`、`kbps`、`ksps`、`Msample/s` 不是 SI units。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S FSV3000 › 型號與文件版次
- 產品系列：R&S®FSV3000 Signal and Spectrum Analyzer。
- 文件：PD 5216.1334.22，Specifications，Version 16.01，August 2025。
- 規格適用條件：環境溫度下存放 3 小時後，30 分鐘 warm-up operation；符合 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；如適用，完成所有 internal automatic adjustments。
- Recommended calibration interval：2 years。
- 注意：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證；data without tolerance limits is not binding。

R&S FSV3000 › 外接附件與相容項目
- External harmonic mixers：[[R&S FSV3030]]、[[R&S FSV3044]]、[[R&S FSV3050]] 搭配 R&S®FSV3-B21 option；來源列 RPG FS-Z60、FS-Z75、FS-Z90、FS-Z110、FS-Z140、FS-Z170、FS-Z220、FS-Z325。
- R&S®FSV3-K553 external frontend control 支援 [[R&S FE44S]]（24 GHz to 44 GHz，Order No. 1338.7001.02）與 [[R&S FE50DTR]]（36 GHz to 50 GHz，Order No. 1347.4099.02）。

- R&S®VSE PC software 另有 basic edition、enterprise edition、dongles 與 software maintenance；需查 [[R&S VSE]] 與其規格書。

- 需要 excess noise ratio（ENR）source，在 DUT input 提供 well-defined white noise。

- Y factor 用於計算 DUT contributed noise、noise figure 與 gain。
- 傳統 noise source 會附 written tables，列出 ENR behavior 隨 frequency 與 temperature 的變化。
- 傳統做法需要將 correction values 手動轉入 noise figure measurement software。
- [[R&S FS-SNS]] 透過在 spectrum analyzer calculations 中包含 electronic ENR 與 environmental temperature tables，消除耗時且容易出錯的手動轉入步驟。

Starlink User Terminal › Recommended RF test equipment
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 推薦：

- Spectrum analyzer：[[R&S FSW]]（43.5 GHz、POI 0.46 µs）、Keysight N9040B UXA。
- Signal generator：[[R&S SMW200A]]（100 kHz–31.8 GHz）、Keysight E8257D PSG。
- Power meter：[[R&S NRX]] with NRP33S（±2.5 dB abs）、Bird 43 wattmeter。
- VNA：Keysight PNA-X（67 GHz）、[[R&S ZNA]] for array calibration。
- Satellite simulator：Terma Ku/Ka-band for loopback EIRP / G/T testing。

這些是該 deck 的推薦清單；正式頻率範圍、POI、功率不確定度、option 需求與 order number 必須回查各產品 datasheet。

Starlink User Terminal › Phased array evolution
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 以 beamformer impact 比較三個版本：

| 版本 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| V1 Circular | 79 DBFs、1,264 elements、motors、NF 3–4 dB |
| Rev3 Gen2 | 16 Shiraz、1,536 elements、NF 2.5–3 dB |
| Rev4 Gen3 | 6 Shiraz daisy-chain、1,536 elements、NF 2–2.5 dB、110° FOV |

來源另稱 Rev4 gains：

- Jitter 9 ms vs 112 ms Rev3。
- Down 307 Mbps。
- Power efficiency +50%。

這些數字連到 [[相控陣列天線]] 與 [[Beamforming]] 主題，但來源未提供 teardown、FCC filing、SpaceX 官方文件或第三方測試報告。

Starlink User Terminal › RF performance 指標
[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 列出下列 key RF metrics：

- [[EIRP]]：32–43 dBW peak；FCC Part 25 limits；uplink PFD -146 dBW/m²。
- G/T：約 11.5 dB/K；antenna gain 37–39 dBi；noise figure 2–2.5 dB。
- Return Loss / VSWR：>14 dB / <1.5:1；來源稱 impedance match critical。
- Phase Noise：<-92 dBc/Hz @100 kHz；來源連到 Shiraz beamformer stability。
- Modulation / BER：QPSK / 64QAM；BER <10⁻⁶ at Eb/N0 4–10 dB。

上述每一項都缺少測試條件、頻段、儀器配置、sample size、terminal revision 與引用來源。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 使用限制
- 本概念頁來自 2022 年 application brochure，屬 application / solution 說明，不是最新產品規格書。
- 不可用本頁取代 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S ZNA]] 等產品 datasheet 的 option、order number 或規格條件。
- 來源沒有給出完整 satellite payload qualification test plan、標準版本、ESA / ECSS 章節或客戶案例。

衛星酬載與元件測試
[[衛星酬載與元件測試]]是針對 satellite transponders、payload subsystems、modules 與 RF / digital components 的設計、開發、驗證與 qualification 測試集合，來源以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器方案為主。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

SDR-assisted UAV security › Jamming detection
[[Software-Defined_Radio_Deployments_in_UAV-Driven_Applications_A_Comprehensive_Review]] 摘錄多項 jamming detection 研究：

- [55] 使用 [[Holy Stone HS720E]]、[[Ettus USRP B210]] 與 [[GNU Radio]]，研究 barrage、protocol-aware、single-tone、successive-pulse jamming attacks。Spectrogram-based CNN model 達到 99.79% accuracy 與 0.03% false alarm rate。
- [56] [[BloodHound]] 使用 [[Ettus X310]] SDR units 與 raw I/Q samples，在 mobile environments 中 early detect / identify jamming；來源稱 detection accuracy 超過 99%。
- [57] [[BloodHound+]] 使用 sparse autoencoders 分析 I/Q grayscale images；在 RJP=0.5、receiver distance=10 m 時 classification accuracy 達 99.7%。

SDR-assisted UAV security › Blockchain-based coordination
[58] 結合 [[Hexacopter Tarot UAVs]]、[[Raspberry Pi 4]]、Metoak binocular camera、[[HackRF One]]、[[USRP Ettus B210]]、Blockchain、smart contracts、asymmetric cryptography 與 ring signatures，用於 signal source identification 與 privacy-preserving task coordination。來源稱 SDR 支援 secure data exchange 與 real-time communication，但該研究仍需與 commercial UAV security deployment 分開看待。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[DUT]]：來源明確以 unmodified 5G DUT 為限制條件；技術方法必須放在 network / infrastructure / orchestration，而不是修改 DUT 本身。
- 與 [[R&S CMX500]]：既有頁面整理 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 Radio Communication Tester、NR / LTE / WLAN signaling、fading、application test 與 automation 平台。本來源只提到 CMX customers 與 5G test setup，沒有明示硬體型號、option 或配置，因此不能把測試結果歸因為正式 CMX500 規格或能力。
- 與 [[Beamforming]]：來源 roadmap 提到 2025–2028 mmWave phased arrays available for field testing；這可作為 [[Beamforming]] / [[相控陣列天線]] 待讀資料線索，但不提供 beamforming 技術定義或量測方法。
- 與 [[Counter-UAV 技術]]：來源 mid-term roadmap 提到 early [[ISAC]] deployment for drone detection & perimeter defense；這與 counter-UAV sensing 主題相鄰，但來源未提供 counter-UAV 系統、sensor spec 或效能數據。
- 與 [[5G NTN validation and testing]]、[[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：本來源處理 private / tactical 5G resilience 與 jamming，不是 NTN channel emulation 或 satellite validation；兩者都屬 contested / non-terrestrial / mission-critical 連線可靠性脈絡，但不可混用測試條件。

2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient › 重點摘要
這份來源是由 [[Randy Schnell]] 製作 / 主講的 company restricted 簡報，題為 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient；raw frontmatter 顯示原檔為 `2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`，轉檔日期為 2026-09-17。來源正文沒有另外標示正式發布日期；本頁以檔名 / raw title 的 2025-12-19 作為來源日期線索。

簡報主張的核心問題是：在不修改 [[DUT]] 的前提下，能否利用 legacy [[Frequency hopping for 5G resilience]] / [[FHSS]] 能力，讓 unmodified 5G DUT connection 對 [[Smart Jamming]] 更具韌性。

主要內容如下：

- 任務背景：tactical edge connectivity 對資料與低延遲需求提高，[[Smart Jamming]] 與 electronic warfare（[[EW]]）威脅增加，private [[5G]] networks 在 military bases / tactical environments 的採用升高。
- 技術映射：來源將問題映射到 5G handover（[[HO]]）signaling 與 frequency-hopping（[[FH]]）signaling；測試設計需使用 [[UE]] capabilities message 回報的 supported bands，並關注 [[3GPP TS 38.300]] 定義的 handover interruption intervals。
- 測試結果：來源聲稱 both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；throughput 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 支撐 video-call reliability 維持，但投影片 OCR 未提供具體 throughput、jitter、packet loss、bandwidth、jammer profile 或 modem 型號數值。
- 現有 defense / Future-G program 脈絡：來源列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]]、[[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing 等項目，說明 FHSS / frequency-agile operation 與 5G / 6G coexistence 的整合方向。
- 時程展望：來源給出 short term 2025–2028、mid term 2028–2032、long term 2032–2035+ 三段式展望，包含 5G tactical networks scale-out、mmWave phased arrays field testing、5G/6G-capable SD radios、early ISAC for drone detection / perimeter defense、URLLC for autonomy、full 6G with integrated sensing、AI-native battlefield connectivity 與 spectrum-aware autonomy。
- Call to action：重新接觸既有 CMX customers，尤其 DOW customers；與 integrators 溝通；保持 tactical patience；提早 engage BDM organization；跨團隊分享 lessons learned。

### Short answer
The provided passages do not yet support a head-to-head Aerospace / Defense competitor comparison for a “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer” solution, because the raw evidence only names “Signal Generator” and “Signal Analyzer” without models, specs, competitor, or test conditions, and the Aerospace / Defense passage only identifies an A&D test presentation/presenter without linking to that solution or to a competitor [99][97].
### Evidence required before making the comparison
| Evidence required | What it must prove | Why it is required |
|---|---|---|
| Exact R&S configuration | The specific signal generator and analyzer models, options, orderable configuration, and applicable specifications; for SMW200A, the KB points to the official configuration guide and specifications, and notes that complete multichannel, MIMO, fading, digital standards, GNSS/avionics, and pulse sequencer specs require separate referenced documents [1][61][63]. | Without exact models/options, a comparison can only be a generic product claim, not a supported technical comparison [1][61]. |
| R&S warranted specification conditions | R&S specs must be used under their stated product-data conditions: storage 3 hours at ambient temperature, 30 minutes warm-up, specified environmental conditions, recommended calibration interval, and applicable internal automatic adjustments; `typ.`, `nom.`, `meas.`, and `n. trc.` values are not warranted for SMW200A [2][27]. | Claims should use warranted specifications with their conditions, not typical or nominal values as guaranteed performance [2][27]. |
| Analyzer specification basis | For analyzers, the KB lists formal specification sources and conditions, such as FSV3000 PD 5216.1334.22 Version 16.01 August 2025, with 3-hour storage, 30-minute warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and automatic adjustments; non-traceable, typical, nominal, measured, and tolerance-free data are not binding [4][8]. | A Signal Analyzer comparison needs binding analyzer specifications and their conditions, not unqualified numbers [4][8]. |
| Application / A&D use-case link | If the use case is satellite payload testing, the KB supports R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A for complete payload testing covering group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality [48]. | This supports an application fit for satellite payload testing, but it is not itself a competitor comparison [48]. |
| Measurement-method evidence | For satellite payload group delay, the KB states that SMW200A generates a multicarrier continuous wave stimulus and FSW performs reference calibration and DUT measurement using phase/amplitude differences [49]. | A fair comparison needs the same measurement principle, setup, DUT conditions, and metrics for both solutions [49]. |
| Competitor official or third-party evidence | R&S internal battle-card claims against competitors require competitor official資料 and third-party evidence before use in customer documents; sales phrases such as “only platform,” “industry-leading,” “widest frequency range,” and “lower TCO” should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications [17][38]. | Competitor superiority, limitation, or TCO claims are unsupported unless the competitor source or third-party evidence states them [17][38]. |
| Same-scope competitor configuration | The Starlink UT test-flow mapping lists R&S FSW vs Keysight N9040B UXA for spectrum analyzer and R&S SMW200A vs Keysight E8257D PSG for signal generator, but says these are deck-level recommendations and formal configuration requires checking product specs, options, frequency range, uncertainty, and test method [40]. | This can identify candidate competitor instruments, but it cannot by itself prove better performance or suitability [40]. |
| Formal datasheet verification for recommended equipment | The Starlink User Terminal page again states that recommended equipment such as R&S FSW, R&S SMW200A, Keysight N9040B UXA, and Keysight E8257D PSG require verification of formal frequency range, POI, power uncertainty, option requirements, and order numbers in each product datasheet [43]. | Deck-level equipment lists must not be used as final technical or procurement evidence [43]. |
| Limits of application brochures | Satellite payload / TVAC application material is solution-level or application-level material and must not replace product datasheets, option/order-number checks, or qualification certificates [23][46]. | Application notes can support use-case context but not formal product qualification or binding specs [23][46]. |
| Market or sales claims separation | Internal market or sales-comparison decks may include competitor positioning, price point, coverage, TCO, or market-share statements, but the KB says such claims require official award notices, PO/PR/lab lists, third-party market reports, or official competitor sources before use as evidence [58][59]. | Market-share, adoption, price, TCO, and “why we win” claims need separate evidence from technical specs [58][59]. |
### Minimum supported comparison package
| Claim type | Required evidence before saying it |
|---|---|
| “Our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution fits Aerospace / Defense use case X.” | A cited source tying the exact R&S generator/analyzer models to that exact use case; the KB currently supports FSW + SMW200A for satellite payload testing, not a general A&D competitor claim [48]. |
| “Our solution outperforms competitor Y.” | R&S warranted specs, competitor official specs or third-party data, same test conditions, and a cited comparison source; R&S battle cards alone are sales positioning and not binding specifications [17][38]. |
| “Our solution needs fewer boxes / lower TCO / higher throughput.” | A cited TCO, workflow, or throughput calculation with configuration, assumptions, and source; the KB flags lower TCO and similar language as sales language or internal comparison unless separately evidenced [17][38][58]. |
| “These instruments are formally recommended for the customer/test flow.” | A source beyond deck-level recommendation, because the Starlink mapping says formal configuration must be verified against datasheets, options, frequency range, uncertainty, and test method [40][43]. |

[[Starlink UT Test Flow]] 推薦：

這些是該 deck 的推薦清單；正式頻率範圍、POI、功率不確定度、option 需求與 order number 必須回查各產品 datasheet。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

- Main competitors offering O-RU conformance testers：[[Keysight]]、[[LitePoint]]、[[Anritsu]]。

- [[LitePoint]] 被描述為 offers integrated O-DU emulator + VSG + VSA。
- [[Anritsu]] 被描述為 offers O-RU testing solution based on O-DU emulator，very minority / no market share；此為 R&S internal statement，需 Anritsu 官方或第三方市場資料補證。
- Keysight hardware comparison 提到 [[Keysight Time Sync Analyzer]]、MTRX、O-DU emulator、10 / 25 / 100GE Ethernet interfaces、GNSS receiver、ToD input、Rubidium option 與 VSA frequency / time error measurement requirement。
- VIAVI / R&S vs Keysight comparison 中列出 price point、test coverage、M-MIMO with BFM、functional test、TCO、reusability 與 TM500 performance test 等 sales comparison；不可當成競品規格驗證。

O-RU tester market and funding › 使用限制
- 本頁屬 [[Market 類資料]]；所有客戶名單、funding、timeline、競品比較與 received / quoted orders 都可能隨 award、project、CRM、product roadmap、software release 與商務條件變動。

- 不可由本頁推論 R&S / VIAVI 已被所有列名 lab 或 customer 正式採購、部署或認證；需逐案以 PO、PR、award notice 或 lab equipment list 補證。

R&S SMW200A › Unresolved
- 來源未標示價格。
- 本頁整合 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（configuration guide，May 2024）與 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（specifications，May 2026）；兩者文件性質不同。報價前應回查正式 PDF、最新 ordering information 與 configure 工具。
